semiconductor_relevance: High — PowerTech specializes in semiconductor assembly and test equipment, which is critical for the production and quality assurance of semiconductor devices.
summary: PowerTech Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of semiconductor assembly and test equipment, focusing on research and development, manufacturing, and sales since its establishment in 1998. The company offers a range of products including IC test systems, discrete test systems, laser marking systems, and vision inspection systems to meet diverse customer needs in semiconductor production.
